actions.tooltip: Run sa: read/write TVars; result is tentative until atomically commits
Apply f(a): build the next atomic action STM b — a not-yet-run TVar action
Run f(a): read/write TVars; all writes still tentative
atomically: check for TVar conflicts.\n  No conflict  → commit all writes at once; b is visible to other threads\n  Conflict     → discard ALL tentative writes; restart the entire chain from run_sa

objects.tooltip: STM a — an atomic action that reads/writes TVars. Not yet executed.
(a ⟶ STM b) — given result a, builds the next atomic action
b — the result value (still tentative, not yet committed)
b — the committed result. All TVar writes from run_sa and run_sb are now atomically visible.
Retry path — the entire transaction restarts. No partial state is visible to other threads.

flows.label: conflict — discard writes, restart entire chain
